lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
A tidy sewing organizer built from 3 hex cells in a row. Two large bins give 4 compartments for fabric, larger notions and tools, and one 3-compartment bin on the end for small haberdashery (buttons, bobbins, needles) keeping everything separated but visible from above.

Propped with small compartment-scale items to show use - they sit low in the deep trays as intended (PROP_BELOW_RIM is expected in a top-down sewing caddy and still verified in the overhead view).

Build verified: no mesh clashes, joints locked, open faces capped.
